descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S10 「现成的 spec：医院卡片和养老院卡片各自在 Pre-Round 打开那个病历；在病历里能到 Encounter 和 Post-Round」 Existing specs: a Hospital card and a Nursing Home card each open that chart on Pre-Round; Encounter and Post-Round reachable from inside

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 5）
  • T4 From within a patient's chart, Encounter and Post-Round are both reachable without returning to the home screen first.（TFA-92579 AC 6）
  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient with MRN, pre-round note and one task; a resident with DOB, unit 'Cedar Wing · Room 12', New Admission today

When Click the card named 'Open chart for <name>', then Begin Encounter (and the Post-Round tab for the resident)

Then URL is /rounding/<that id> or /snf/<that id>, the Pre-Round notes are visible, Encounter Notes and Post-Round open from inside the chart

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Only a failure at or before the Encounter Notes / 'No note generated yet.' assertions counts for TC-01; later assertions (Note Format options TFA-92599, Dashboard, Task Export, Handoff, Quick Dictation, Scan, Inbox, Settings) route to their own TC. …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S10

Existing specs: a Hospital card and a Nursing Home card each open that chart on Pre-Round; Encounter and Post-Round reachable from inside

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — every rounding-list navigation control reaches its destination — expected
  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — the nursing-home hub reaches add, scan, inbox, task export, handoff, settings, and every chart tab — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec): its fixtures are fresh @roundai.test accounts made with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
